title: feat(capabilities): requires record-context mounts the record-context service, so get_record_context is served over MCP
body:
Fixes #37189

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md (the `requires` table lists no `record-context` row) and skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md (the generated capability table; see the open gap below)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：应用声明「记录情境」能力后（包括只发布编译产物的应用），外部 AI 经 MCP 连接时多出一个读取单条记录情境包的工具；没有声明的部署前后完全一样。
- 为什么做：属于「记录范围的 AI 问答」专题；此前只有宿主在代码里手工挂上服务才有这个工具，纯元数据应用写了情境包也没有人读。
- 出错会怎样：只影响声明了该能力的应用，最坏是该工具缺失或读不出情境包，其他功能不受影响；回退本改动即可恢复原状。
- 要你做的：可能要批准一次——新能力在平台目录技能页上还缺一行（受管的技能文件，本单未获授权改动），若席位把这一行并入本改动，它就需要维护者批准后才能合并。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `record-context` joins `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS`, with a `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` row `{ package: '@objectstack/service-record-context', edition: 'open' }` (the shape every sibling open service row has). Requested, never on the always-on slate. `defineStack` now accepts `requires: ['record-context']`; near misses stay refused. The `aiContexts` description names the token (regenerated reference: `content/docs/references/api/package-api-assembled.mdx`).
- **`@objectstack/core`**: `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS['record-context']` names `RecordContextServicePlugin` with identities `com.objectstack.service.record-context` and the class name. No constructor argument (`resolveCapabilityArgument` answers `undefined` for it).
- **Readers (ADR-0049)**: `os serve`'s capability resolver and `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack` (`constructServedProviders`) both read that one table, so neither needed a source edit; `serve.ts` is unchanged on purpose (its `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` docblock: "Adding a built-in capability is an edit THERE"). What each reader needed is the provider package: `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/verify` now depend on `@objectstack/service-record-context` (lockfile updated), and the cli vitest config gains the anchored source alias its identity test needs.
- **Hand-mounted plugin**: the existing `providesCapability` rule applies unchanged: a host that already mounts the plugin (by its registered name or its class) keeps its own instance and the resolver mounts no second one.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/37189-record-context-capability.md`, minor on spec, core, cli and verify.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.test.ts`: the token, its provider row and edition, not always-on, classified installable when absent and ok when installed; `defineStack` accepts `requires: ['record-context']`, and refuses `record_context`, `recordContext`, `record-contexts` and `context` with `STACK_CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN` / 422.
- `packages/cli/test/serve-capability-identity.test.ts`: the expected provider name row; the existing drift block imports the package and pins that the plugin registers that name.
- `packages/verify/src/harness.required-providers.test.ts`, a new top-level describe (three bootStack boots):
  - the token plus one pack: `tools/list` over the live `/mcp` route carries `get_record_context`, and a `tools/call` answers the pack (record title and pack label);
  - control, the same app without the token: no provider, `tools/list` has `get_record` and not `get_record_context`;
  - a host-mounted stand-in under the provider's real name: `constructServedProviders` builds no second one, and after a boot the `record-context` service is the host's.
  The file's budget line now names nine boots; its number is unchanged at 20 and its CI re-measure is owed (local readings: 5.9 s for the first six cases, 10.0 s with the three new ones).

## Acceptance notes

- **Open gap, owned by the seat (why this PR is red: Test Core's spec suite, and `check:skill-refs` / `check:skill-identifier-liveness` in Lint and Repo Gates).** `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts#CAPABILITY_ROWS` is pinned exhaustive over `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS`, and its rendered page is `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md`. Adding the token therefore needs one catalog row and a regenerated skills page; both are outside this card's file surface (`skills/**` is fenced, Tier H), so they are not in this diff. Measured on this branch: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-refs` exits 1 with "capability record-context: no catalog line (the table is exhaustive over PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS)"; `scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts` has 5 failures from the same cause. The hand-written text ceiling there has zero headroom (6875 bytes, 1719 tokens, at the ceiling of 1719): a row such as `'record-context': 'get_record_context over MCP'` (27 bytes) needs 27 bytes cut elsewhere in that module, or the ratchet's raise path. Separately, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness` holds `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`'s `requires` table exhaustive over the vocabulary and exits 1: that table has no `record-context` row (its other remedy, a gap-ledger entry, is maintainer-only). All three paths are generated or taught skill text for this token, and none is in this diff.
- The hosted kernel and EE are out of scope (cloud#4978). Cloud's capability loader reads the same vocabulary; a hosted app that declares the token is that card's to serve.
- Auto-mounting on the presence of `aiContexts` is not done, per the card.
- `RecordContextServicePlugin`'s own docblock still says "Composition is explicit: mount it in `plugins[]`". That file is fenced off for this card (open PR on that package); its wording can name the token later.
- Not on the always-on slate: verified by the spec pin and by the no-token control on both boots.

## Verification

First files to read, by risk:
1. `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts`: the new row (its identities are what the hand-mount rule matches).
2. `packages/verify/src/harness.required-providers.test.ts`: the new describe, the only end-to-end pin.
3. `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`: the token and the provider row.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/harness.required-providers.test.ts` — expect 10/10, including the three `requires: ['record-context']` cases.

<details><summary>Local test runs (head a8f21fd3b; all under scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh)</summary>

- Build closure `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@objectstack/verify... --filter=@objectstack/cli...`: VERDICT command-exit 0 (rebuilt after merging origin/main 1d20c45c7).
- `@objectstack/spec` full vitest: 985/986 files, 29969 passed, 5 failed, 1 todo. All 5 failures are `scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts`, the open gap above.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit project: 445/445 files, 6354/6354 tests. Integration tier not run locally: the diff touches no spawn entry; CI runs it.
- `@objectstack/verify`: 55/55 files, 503/503 tests. `@objectstack/core`: 157/157 files, 3761/3761 tests.
- Typecheck spec, core, verify, cli: exit 0 (test-layer gates OK).
- ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) over the changed `.ts` files: exit 0. CI runs the full `pnpm lint`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the provider row</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` renamed the `'record-context'` key in `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 13b7b4b9dc9d to 6b10d63f250b; verify aliases core to source).

- Ablated: `harness.required-providers.test.ts` 1 failed / 9 passed — the token-and-pack case; the no-token control and the hand-mount case stay green, as they should.
- Restored: blob back to HEAD 13b7b4b9dc9d, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Same mutation built into core's `dist` (preflight: marker in 2 built files): cli `serve-capability-vocabulary.test.ts` 3 failed / 13 passed (every provider token in the vocabulary, open-edition package agreement, every open-edition token has a serve mount). Restored and rebuilt (marker absent from all 20 built files): 16/16.

</details>

<details><summary>Container run: os serve on a compiled artifact</summary>

A one-object app with one `aiContexts` pack and `requires: ['record-context']`, compiled by `os build` (artifact keys: manifest, objects, aiContexts, requires), then booted by `os serve --dev` with no config file present ("No objectstack.config.ts found — booting from artifact").

- With the token: the plugin banner lists `RecordContextServicePlugin` and `MCPServerPlugin`; `tools/list` over `/api/v1/mcp` with a minted key answers 20 tools including `get_record_context`; `tools/call get_record_context` on an inserted record answers the pack (`pack.name` rcprobe_policy_brief, the record's display name), not an error.
- Control, same app rebuilt without the token: no `RecordContextServicePlugin` in the banner; 19 tools, `get_record_context` absent.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates: dispatch-gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 137 commands on the merged tree; each run with its exit code recorded. `--ran`: "137 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 133 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (4 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- Exit 1, the open gap: `check:skill-refs` (no catalog line for record-context), `spec check:generated` (the same skill-refs artifact), `check:skill-identifier-liveness` (skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md's `requires` table, held exhaustive over the vocabulary, has no `record-context` row).
- Exit 1 then fixed in this diff: `check:test-source-alias` (the two edited suites now pay their source-reach loads at module top); re-run exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED, exit 3 (prerequisite): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone), `spec check:skill-examples` (client-react unbuilt), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` (unbuilt packages). CI runs them.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: VERDICT clean exit 0 (origin/main and the PRs sharing the lockfile and the two manifests merge cleanly).

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; the full `pnpm lint` is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [ ] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (The docs reference is; the skills catalog page is the open gap above.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
